name: PvP Events
description: Start a PvP event with bots from the Community Board: free-for-all, King of the Hill, team deathmatch, Korean-style one-at-a-time, duels and 9v9, or watch bots fight. Scenario presets with roles and classes, kill scoring, respawns, a results table with kills and damage, and you are put back where you stood.
author: sateriok
